message.reasoning_content:
The watch is a Rolex Submariner Date, black dial, black ceramic bezel (Cerachrom), Oyster bracelet, stainless steel. The dial shows "SUBMARINER 1000ft = 300m" text on two lines with "SUPERLATIVE CHRONOMETER OFFICIALLY CERTIFIED". This suggests the newer 41mm Submariner Date 126610LN (2020+), which has the two-line text (the 116610LN had three lines: "SUBMARINER", "1000ft = 300m", "SUPERLATIVE CHRONOMETER OFFICIALLY CERTIFIED" — actually the 116610LN had the same layout? Let me recall.

The 116610LN dial: "ROLEX / OYSTER PERPETUAL DATE" at top, then "SUBMARINER" with "1000ft = 300m" below, and "SUPERLATIVE CHRONOMETER OFFICIALLY CERTIFIED" — actually the 116610LN had 4 lines of text: SUBMARINER, 1000ft=300m, SUPERLATIVE CHRONOMETER, OFFICIALLY CERTIFIED. Yes both have similar.

Difference: 126610LN is 41mm, slimmer lugs, and the crown at 6 o'clock... The "Swiss Made" at the bottom with the crown between Swiss and Made is the 126610 (2020+). Yes! The 126610LN has "SWISS [crown] MADE" with the coronet at 6 o'clock on the dial. The 116610LN had just "SWISS MADE" without the crown. In the photo, at the bottom of the dial there appears to be a small crown symbol between SWISS and MADE. Let me look... "SWISS ... MADE" with something in the middle. It appears there's a small coronet. That indicates 126610LN.

Also the bezel numerals and dial text appear larger, consistent with 41mm.

So reference 126610LN, movement automatic (Calibre 3235), case stainless steel, bracelet metal (Oyster, stainless steel).

Confidence: quite high, ~0.8.

Model family: Submariner Date.
